info.name: Coaching Center Management System API
info.description: Production-grade Postman Collection (v2.1) covering Single-Institution Architecture, Authentication, Google OAuth, Student Onboarding & Approvals, Teacher/Student Registration, and Institution Management.

request.description: Returns uptime, server environment, and system health status.

Authenticates Teacher account.
Authenticates Student account.
Rotates refresh token and issues fresh access token.
Initiates password recovery link via email.
Resets password using single-use verification token.
Revokes current session or all device sessions.
Revokes all active login sessions across all devices for the authenticated user and clears current device cookies.
Lists all active, non-revoked login sessions for the authenticated user with IP, device/user agent, created timestamp, and expiration timestamp.

request.description: Protected: Administrator updates institution branding, location, phone, email, and admin contact details.
Protected: Authenticated user retrieves their full profile, permissions, and role-specific academic or faculty information.
Protected: Authenticated user updates their personal details and role-specific profile attributes.
Protected: Authenticated user changes their account password. Verifies current password and revokes all other active sessions.

query.description: Partial search on name, email, phone
Filter by role: ADMIN, TEACHER, STUDENT
Filter by status: PENDING_ACTIVATION, ACTIVE, INACTIVE, BLOCKED

request.description: Protected: Administrator retrieves filtered, searched, and paginated users across the entire institution.
Protected: Administrator retrieves complete profile details of a specific user by ID.
Protected: Administrator updates a user's operational status (ACTIVE, INACTIVE, BLOCKED). Automatically revokes active sessions if set to BLOCKED or INACTIVE. Admin self-blocking is rejected.
Protected: Administrator soft-deletes a user account (sets deletedAt timestamp, sets status to INACTIVE, revokes all sessions). Admin self-deletion is strictly prevented.
Protected (Admin): Grant or update delegated administrative permissions (MANAGE_ATTENDANCE, MANAGE_EXAMS, MANAGE_ROUTINES) for a specific teacher.
Protected: Administrator creates a new academic batch with name, fee, and status. Sets batchId in environment.

query.description: Filter by status: UPCOMING, ONGOING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED

request.description: Protected: Authenticated users list batches with universal QueryBuilder filtering, search, and pagination.
Protected: Retrieves single batch details with routine schedule and enrolled student counters.
Protected: Administrator updates batch name, fee, or operational status.
Protected: Administrator soft-deletes batch (sets deletedAt timestamp and updates status to CANCELLED).
Protected: Active student requests enrollment into a batch. Creates enrollment record in PENDING state awaiting admin approval.

item.name: ✅ Get Pending Enrollment Requests (Admin Only — QueryBuilder)

query.description: Search student name, email, phone or batch name

request.description: Protected: Administrator retrieves all pending student enrollment applications across all batches using QueryBuilder.
Protected: Administrator approves student enrollment, setting status to ENROLLED and approvedAt timestamp.
Protected: Administrator rejects student enrollment request, setting status to REJECTED.
Protected: Administrator directly adds an active student into a batch (immediately ENROLLED with approvedAt timestamp).

query.description: Filter by enrollment status: ENROLLED, PENDING, REJECTED

request.description: Protected: Administrator and Teacher view paginated roster of students in a specific batch with student & guardian details.
Protected: Administrator drops / removes a student from a batch enrollment.
Protected: Authenticated student views their enrolled batches, fee amounts, and class timetable routines.

item.name: ✅ Create Routine Slot (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Protected: Admin or Teacher with MANAGE_ROUTINES creates a class routine slot with room, teacher, and batch conflict validation.

query.description: Search subject, room, teacher name, or batch name

request.description: Protected: Authenticated user lists routine slots with universal QueryBuilder search, filters, and pagination.
Protected: Retrieves single routine slot details with assigned faculty and batch metadata.
Protected: Retrieves complete day-grouped weekly schedule (SATURDAY through FRIDAY) for a specific batch.
Protected: Administrator or Teacher retrieves full teaching schedule for a specific teacher.
Protected: Authenticated teacher retrieves their personal weekly teaching schedule grouped by day.
Protected: Authenticated student retrieves aggregated weekly class timetable across all their active batch enrollments.

request.description: Protected: Updates routine slot parameters with conflict validation excluding current slot.

item.name: ✅ Delete Routine Slot (Admin or Authorized Teacher)

request.description: Dynamically streams an official weekly class schedule timetable PDF in A4 format with zero cloud storage usage. Set download=true for file attachment download or download=false for inline browser rendering.

item.name: ✅ Create Monthly Stripe Checkout Session (Student Only)

request.description: Protected (Student): Initializes a secure Stripe Checkout session for a specific monthly fee billing period. Automatically charges the effective monthly fee (Batch Fee - Flat Student Discount), validates active enrollment, prevents duplicate monthly fee payments, and returns the Stripe checkout URL.

item.name: ✅ Collect Manual Monthly Fee Payment (Admin Only)

request.description: Protected (Admin): Records an offline/manual cash or mobile banking (bKash/Nagad/Rocket/Cash/Bank) monthly fee collection. Prevents duplicate payments for the same billing month, creates receipt, records immutable audit log, and asynchronously dispatches receipt email with attached PDF.

item.name: ✅ Configure Historical Billing Start & Opening Dues / Flat Discount (Admin Only)

request.description: Protected (Admin): Configures historical opening dues and custom flat monthly discount waivers for a student enrollment. Allows migrating students from prior terms with initial due balances and special monthly fee discounts.

item.name: ✅ Check My Outstanding Monthly Dues (Student Only)

request.description: Protected (Student): Retrieves comprehensive personal due summary across all enrolled batches. Returns batch monthly fee, flat discount waiver, effective monthly fee, itemized list of unpaid billing months, opening balance, and total outstanding due.

item.name: ✅ Monitor All Student Dues & Defaulters (Admin Only — QueryBuilder)

request.description: Protected (Admin): Analyzes all active student enrollments, computes total outstanding dues across the academy, and generates an itemized list of fee defaulters with unpaid month counts and opening balances.
Protected (Student): Retrieves paginated personal payment transaction history with billing period, payment method, amount, status, and receipt reference.

item.name: ✅ All System Payment Transactions (Admin Only — QueryBuilder)

request.description: Protected (Admin): Universally searches, filters, and paginates all financial transactions across the institution using QueryBuilder.
Protected (Admin): Aggregates total institution revenue, total transactions count, status breakdowns (completed/pending/failed), payment method distributions, and monthly revenue trends.

request.description: Protected (Admin & Student): Retrieves full receipt metadata by transaction ID, including receipt number, billing month/year, formatted billing period, payment method, student profile, and batch fee info.
